24 pamilya mula sa Barangay Baesa ang nakatanggap ng tulong pinansyal mula sa Pamahalaang Lungsod Quezon matapos ang naganap na sunog noong February 17, 2026.

Kasama sa pamamahagi ng tulong si Social Services Development Department OIC Lorelei Salvador. 

Layon ng lungsod na agad na makabangon ang mga pamilyang naaapektuhan ng sunog sa barangay.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place in connection with the Election for 25 Members of the Bar Council of Delhi at the Delhi High Court compound on 21st, 22nd & 23rd February 2026.

Timings: 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM

📍ROAD CLOSURE
-Sher Shah Road (from India Gate & Mathura Road sides) will remain closed during polling hours.

📍 ROUTES TO AVOID
-Tilak Marg
-C-Hexagon, India Gate
-Zakir Hussain Marg
-Sher Shah Road
-Purana Quila Road

📍PARKING & ADVISORY
-No halting/parking at C-Hexagon & surrounding roads; violators will be towed to Traffic Pit near Bhairon Mandir
-Advocates may park at Zoo Parking & Gate No. 5A, National Stadium
-Commuters are advised to avoid affected routes, use public transport & plan travel to ISBT/Railway Stations/Airports in advance.

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

data.text:
Napakalaking kagaguhan at kabalintunaan na sa ika-40 na anibersaryo ng pag-aalsang EDSA, idedeklara ng pulis na “no rally zone” ang palibot ng EDSA Shrine. 

Reminder lang po, ang EDSA Shrine ay shrine hindi lang ni Mama Mary kundi shrine in honor ng People Power Revolution. Tingnan ninyo ang mural sa loob ng simbaan na yan, puro image ng rally at nag-aalsang mammayan. Ulitin ko, REVOLUTION ang ginugunita sa Feb. 25 tapos ipagbabawal ninyo ang rally? Susmaryosep. 

#EDSA40
